title: Restyling: is it worth remaking, and is there enough fabric?

say: Restyling: is it worth remaking, and is there enough fabric?
This is the video for module 4 of Fashion Basics and Clothing Alterations.
Clients bring precious garments: a mother's lace iro and buba, a gown worn once, a husband's old kaftan. Restyling gives them something new without buying new cloth.

say: But the fabric is limited to what is already there, and the work takes longer than a normal alteration. So assessment is everything.

say: Hold the fabric to the light and pull gently on the bias. Thin or weak fabric, especially at underarms and collars, will tear when re-sewn. Look for uneven fading at folds and seams, and chalk around stains and holes.
If any check fails, discuss it with the client before you agree the job.

say: Label each piece on the wrong side with an arrow for the lengthwise grain. It usually runs from shoulder to hem. A piece cut off grain will twist and hang badly, even if it is the right size.

say: For example, Ngozi brings her late father's cotton kaftan and wants an A-line skirt. After unpicking and pressing, each body panel gives a clean 70 by 100 cm, with the grain running down the length.

say: Each skirt piece is 58 cm wide and 65 cm long. 58 fits in 70, and 65 fits in 100, with the grain matching. It fits.

say: For example, Aisha wants her brother's shirt as a fitted blouse. With 8 cm of ease, her bust target is 104 cm, so 16 cm comes out. Divided by four, each side seam moves 4 cm.

panel.heading: An oversized shirt into a fitted blouse
items: Bust 120 to 104: move each side seam 4 cm
Waist 118 to 92: remove 26 cm
Side seams 5 cm each: 20 cm
Two back darts of 3 cm: 6 cm

say: Her waist target is 92 cm, so 26 cm must come out.

panel.heading: An oversized shirt into a fitted blouse
items: Bust 120 to 104: move each side seam 4 cm
Waist 118 to 92: remove 26 cm
Side seams 5 cm each: 20 cm
Two back darts of 3 cm: 6 cm

say: Moving the side seams 5 cm each removes 20 cm. Two new back darts of 3 cm remove 6 more. Total, 26.
Sew the side seam and sleeve seam in one continuous line, then shorten the sleeves to the elbow.

say: A men's shirt shoulder will sit beyond her shoulder bone. She can accept a soft, dropped-shoulder look, which suits casual styles. Aisha chose this.

say: For example, Funke's sleeveless maxi is 145 cm long. She wants 120 cm with cap sleeves for church. Add a 3 cm hem, and the cut line is 123 cm from the shoulder.

panel.heading: A maxi dress gains sleeves
items: Cut line: 120 plus 3 cm hem = 123 cm
Strip below: 22 cm tall, 180 cm around
Two sleeves: 46 + 46 = 92 cm wide
88 cm left for a head wrap or belt

say: That leaves a strip 22 cm tall and 180 cm around. Each sleeve is 14 cm tall, so it fits, cut on the same grain as the dress.

say: Two sleeves need 92 cm of width. The sleeve is 2 cm wider than her 44 cm armhole, and that small extra is eased in at the shoulder.

say: 88 cm is left for a matching head wrap or belt. But pin a paper sleeve on the dress, and get her approval, before you cut the hem.

say: To remember. Check strength, fading and marks first. Unpick, press, label the grain and measure.
Every new piece must fit with the grain the same way. Agree a written brief, and pin a paper pattern before you cut.
